name: A/B Testing Dashboard
short_description: Multi-page statistical analysis web app that analyzes experiment data and recommends Launch / Iterate / Kill using p-values, Bayesian Monte Carlo, power analysis, and sample size calculations. Generates consulting-grade PDF reports.
detailed_description: A comprehensive A/B testing dashboard that combines frequentist and Bayesian statistical methods to analyze experiment data and provide actionable recommendations (Launch, Iterate, Kill). Built with FastAPI, SciPy, and Bootstrap 5. Generates consulting-grade PDF reports for stakeholders.

finance: Decision framework: Launch / Iterate / Kill recommendations
freelance: Full-stack A/B testing dashboard from concept to deployment
Statistical methods: Bayesian + frequentist + power analysis
biotech: Statistical validation framework applicable to biotech experiments

highlights: Implements Bayesian Monte Carlo for probabilistic decision-making
Statistical power analysis and sample size calculation
Generates consulting-grade PDF reports with visualizations
